[F004] Repo: DontPanic · Env: dev · Project: (none)

**Finding 1 (high, correctness — `plain_consequence` mutated by brand normalization).** Fixed at the source. `_brief_fields` (scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/event_copy.py:700) now returns brief-sourced slots verbatim, and `render()` (scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/event_copy.py:857) no longer wraps any of them in `normalize_brand_drift`. I went one step past the recommendation and dropped the rewrite for `what_changes` / `user_impact` too, not just `plain_consequence`: `decision_consequence` and `what_changes` can both interpolate the plan title, so normalizing one and not the other would render a single brief in two brand spellings. D010's rewrite keeps its original scope — the fallback path for events carrying no brief still normalizes, now inside `_brief_fields._row`, so table copy authored in this repo is unchanged in behavior. Recorded as D015 in the plan's decisions.jsonl.

**Finding 2 (medium, test_coverage — fixtures carried no rewrite-sensitive text).** `BRIEF_UPFRONT` is now deliberately rewrite-sensitive: its description contains `Run jarvis approve F004.`, its impact summary contains `run jarvis resume`, and its plan title is `Jarvis [orchestrate] decision brief at gates` with `feature_id=None`, so that title is also the subject interpolated into `decision_consequence` — every text slot on that brief hits a `_BRAND_REWRITES` entry.
